facts.fact: The ITU repository lists Egypt Vision 2030 and the Digital Egypt Strategy as the country's strategy and says the countries it lists have adopted one; no adopting act is named, so this is dated by the repository's 2025 publication year.
The repository gives the time frame of Egypt Vision 2030 and the Digital Egypt Strategy as 2016 - ongoing.
The repository names the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology as lead/owner of Egypt Vision 2030 and the Digital Egypt Strategy.

systems.tiers: named with the Digital Egypt Strategy in one entry

note: The entry headed DR Congo describes an Egypt Digital Transformation Strategy 2020 - ongoing under ITIDA; it is mislabelled and gives no fact here.
